action_instruction: Waiting while checking Processor, Memory, and Storage option groups
intent: PRIMARY: inspect the Processor, Memory, and Storage option groups for {{global.laptop_product}}; role=text | HINTS: container=main configurator
rationale: All requested selector options and the disabled 4 TB reason are visible and confirmed.

action_instruction: Reading the processor option list and price adjustments
intent: the processor option names and listed price adjustments

action_params.condition: Processor lists Core Ultra 5 / Core Ultra 7 / Core Ultra 9 with +$0 / +$250 / +$550.
action_params.query: the processor option names and listed price adjustments
action_params.expected_value: Core Ultra 5 +$0 / Core Ultra 7 +$250 / Core Ultra 9 +$550

output_value: Core Ultra 5 +$0 / Core Ultra 7 +$250 / Core Ultra 9 +$550

action_instruction: Reading the memory option list and price adjustments
intent: the memory option capacities and listed price adjustments

action_params.condition: Memory lists 16 GB / 32 GB / 64 GB with +$0 / +$200 / +$500.
action_params.query: the memory option capacities and listed price adjustments

action_instruction: Reading the storage option list and price adjustments
intent: the storage option capacities and listed price adjustments

action_params.condition: Storage lists 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB / 4 TB with +$0 / +$150 / +$350 / +$700.
action_params.query: the storage option capacities and listed price adjustments

action_instruction: Checking the 4 TB storage option availability and reason
intent: whether the 4 TB storage option is visible, disabled, and includes its availability reason

action_params.condition: The 4 TB option remains visible, is disabled, and shows the reason "Workstation only".
action_params.query: whether the 4 TB storage option is visible, disabled, and includes its availability reason

assertion_tree.description: Processor lists Core Ultra 5 / Core Ultra 7 / Core Ultra 9 with +$0 / +$250 / +$550, Memory lists 16 GB / 32 GB / 64 GB with +$0 / +$200 / +$500, Storage lists 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB / 4 TB with +$0 / +$150 / +$350 / +$700, and the 4 TB option remains visible, is disabled, and shows the reason "Workstation only".

sub_results.description: Processor lists Core Ultra 5 / Core Ultra 7 / Core Ultra 9 with +$0 / +$250 / +$550.
sub_results.expected: Core Ultra 5 +$0 / Core Ultra 7 +$250 / Core Ultra 9 +$550

variable_refs.{{processor_options_check}}: Core Ultra 5 +$0 / Core Ultra 7 +$250 / Core Ultra 9 +$550

sub_results.description: Memory lists 16 GB / 32 GB / 64 GB with +$0 / +$200 / +$500.
Storage lists 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB / 4 TB with +$0 / +$150 / +$350 / +$700.
The 4 TB option remains visible, is disabled, and shows the reason "Workstation only".

assertion_tree.verification: The Processor selector lists Core Ultra 5 / Core Ultra 7 / Core Ultra 9 with +$0 / +$250 / +$550; the Memory selector lists 16 GB / 32 GB / 64 GB with +$0 / +$200 / +$500; the Storage selector lists 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB / 4 TB with +$0 / +$150 / +$350 / +$700; and the 4 TB option is visible, disabled, and shows the reason "Workstation only".
